Monaer brake fluid and brake care

DOT 4 and DOT 5.1 fluid, plus the items that finish a clean brake job.

Check my car on WhatsAppCall 016-759 5988

Brake fluid and brake care

  • Monaer brake fluid in DOT 4 and DOT 5.1
  • Monaer brake parts cleaner spray
  • High-temperature anti-noise grease
  • Monaer work gloves

Product details on this site are as published by Monaer Brake System Malaysia. Ask us for the details of your exact part.

Signs your brake fluid needs changing

  • The brake light stays on after the handbrake is down
  • The pedal feels soft or needs a deeper press
  • The fluid in the reservoir looks dark
  • Your service book says it is due

Brakes are a safety part. Always confirm the exact part for your car with us or your workshop before fitting.

How to get Monaer pads for your car

  1. 1

    Send your car details

    Make, model, year and engine on WhatsApp. A photo of your road tax or the old pad helps.

Questions drivers and workshops ask

DOT 4 or DOT 5.1: which one for my car?

Use the grade your car maker specifies, shown on the reservoir cap or in the owner manual. Send us your model if you are not sure.

Do you supply brake care items to workshops?

Yes. WhatsApp us with what you need and how many.

  • Brake pads
  • Brake discs
